summary: Florida Power & Light Co. filed an 8-K disclosing the sale of $255,394,000 principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due June 1, 2076, bearing interest at Compounded SOFR minus 0.35%, paid quarterly. The notes were sold under an effective shelf registration statement (333-278184). No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine debt issuance by a public utility, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or restructuring elements. The filing merely reports a capital markets transaction and exhibits legal opinions.
